svg.text: RECON • DETECT • ALERT — Beta 1 Release Architecture • Pure Browser Client • PWA Offline Precached

g.text: • Native Canvas Test Card Pattern Fallback
• L2 Trigger: Left Mouse Click & Drag
• R2 Trigger: Right Mouse Context Click
• Left Stick: Primary Reticle Aim (50% speed)
• Right Stick: PiP Zoom Window Pan & ROI
• L3 / R3: Tactical Themes & Declutter Toggle
→ Reticle Sculpting: direct stick editing in design mode
• Mode Cycle: AIM ROI → DIGITAL ZOOM → TOOLS
• Zoom, Pan, Heatmap, Ring Buffer, Voice Settings
• Aspect-ratio preserved camera rendering + Digital Zoom (1.0x - 8.0x)
• Real-time Touch & Joystick Panning with Boundary Clamping
• 160×90 downsampled luma matrix delta against sliding background
• >18% Global Shift Cutoff eliminates scope shake / wind / jitter
• Samples ROI target (roiX, roiY) with sub-pixel sharpness
• Resizable floating window (#pipWindow) with Corner Resizers
• Heatmap Centroid Vector → Relative Angle to Scope Reticle
• Custom Keywords: High / Low / Left / Right / Clock directions
• Audio Throttling & Queue Management: Prevents speech cascades
• Quick Mute / Unmute Button on Main Header with State Synced Icon
• Audition Sample Test button in Options Panel
• Fullscreen Reticle Studio: Dedicated interactive design screen
• Parametric Geometry: Inner / Outer Ring, Gap, Crosshair Thickness
• Circle & Dot Toggles: Mil-dot style hashmarks, target bullseye
• Direct Controller Stick Sculpting: Left stick alters thickness & size
• Right Stick adjusts open-center gap and ring diameter live
• Click Calibration Engine: MOA / MRAD Turret Click Offset Calculator
(Calculates L/R & Up/Down clicks from target POI to POE impact point)
• Custom Scope Image Overlay Loader (PNG / WebP / SVG transparent reticles)
NATIVE-RES RAM RING BUFFER (ZERO DISK I/O)
• Uncompressed / Native-Res Circular Frame Queue in RAM
• Configurable Buffer Duration: 5 to 60 seconds rolling history
• Configurable Target Buffer Rate: 5 to 30 FPS
• Memory Guardrails: Live RAM Budget Estimator (Used / Free MB)
• Automatic frame eviction prevents tab crash or OOM pressure
• Triggers automatically on Ring Double-Tap, Controller Circle, or UI button
• Auto-saves into permanent IndexedDB storage without UI hitch
• 100% Fullscreen playback with native video resolution
• Scrubbing Timeline Bar: drag / click to pinpoint exact impact frame
• Variable Playback Rates: Normal 1.0x, Slow-Mo 0.25x & 0.5x, Fast 2.0x
• Single-frame Step Forward / Backward for forensic shot analysis
• Gamepad Playback Controls: D-pad scrub, Cross Play/Pause, Circle Exit
• Collapsible Clips Drawer with thumbnail previews and timestamps
• Fullscreen Analysis Player with Loop, Scrub, and Frame Stepping
• WebM Export Engine: Re-encodes native frames to standalone .webm
• One-click download to local filesystem without cloud upload
• 29 Precached Core Assets: HTML, JS, CSS, SVG Icons, Manifest
• 100% Offline Capable: Installs on Chromebook, Android, Windows, Mac
• Zero cloud server requirements; zero npm dependencies at runtime
• MOA / MRAD Turret Click Offset Calculator
